title: Normalized QuickGO Reference Concordance
description: Validation contract for descriptive citation inventory overlap between source claims and external QuickGO captures under Option A (protein entity / source record level). Preserves namespace integrity (PMID: vs GO_REF:) without external lookups, distinguishing comparable canonical CURIEs from uninterpretable raw tokens.

protein_id.description: Resolved catalog entity identifier from candidate v0.3.0 mfp_proteins.csv.

source_id.description: Canonical source catalog identifier (e.g. SRC_MOONPROT, SRC_MULTITASKPROTDB_II, SRC_PLANTMP).

source_references_count.description: Count of distinct comparable canonical reference CURIEs (e.g. PMID:<digits>) associated with the source record, or null if outside slice or extraction incomplete.

source_unresolved_references_count.description: Count of raw source citation tokens that could not be interpreted as canonical publication CURIEs, or null if outside slice or extraction incomplete.

quickgo_references_count.description: Count of distinct canonical reference CURIEs associated with QuickGO annotations for this accession, or null if unlinked/absent.

shared_references_count.description: Exact citation set intersection count |R_src ∩ R_qgo| over comparable CURIEs, or null if either side is unavailable/indeterminate.

source_only_references_count.description: Source-only citation count |R_src \ R_qgo|, or null if either side is unavailable/indeterminate.

quickgo_only_references_count.description: QuickGO-only citation count |R_qgo \ R_src|, or null if either side is unavailable/indeterminate.

jaccard_similarity.description: Citation Jaccard coefficient |R_src ∩ R_qgo| / |R_src ∪ R_qgo| over comparable CURIEs, or null if non-evaluable.

reference_concordance_status.description: Binary evaluability flag enforcing non-empty citation sets and biological identity prerequisites.

comparison_completeness.description: Completeness status of reference inventory interpretation: complete (100% tokens resolved to CURIEs), partial (some unresolved tokens present), uninterpretable (all tokens unresolved), empty (observed record with 0 citations), indeterminate (outside slice or extraction incomplete).

primary_non_evaluable_reason.description: Governing reason code when reference comparison is not evaluable, or null.

secondary_non_evaluable_reasons.description: Semicolon-delimited list of all simultaneous observed reference comparison limitations, or null.

shared_reference_ids.description: Semicolon-delimited list of shared canonical CURIEs (sorted deterministically), or null.

unresolved_reference_ids.description: Semicolon-delimited list of raw source reference tokens that could not be interpreted as canonical CURIEs, or null.

identity_review_status.description: Propagated identity comparability flag from coverage.
